info.name: Delivery App Backend APIs
info.description: Complete API collection for Delivery App backend with all endpoints and examples for testing

item.name: POST addAddress
item.description: Add a new address for authenticated user

item.name: GET getAddressesByUserId
item.description: Get all addresses for authenticated user

item.name: GET getAddressesByCustomerUserId
item.description: Get addresses for a customer (Admin only)

item.name: GET getAddressById
item.description: Get a specific address by ID

item.name: POST setDefaultAddress
item.description: Set an address as default for authenticated user

item.name: POST register
item.description: Register a new admin (requires secret key)

item.name: POST login
item.description: Admin login with email and password

item.name: POST createCategory
item.description: Create a new category with image

item.name: PUT updateCategory
item.description: Update a category with optional image

item.name: PUT updateOrderStatus
item.description: Update order status (PROCESSING, PACKED, ON_THE_WAY, DELIVERED, CANCELLED)

item.name: GET getOrderDetails
item.description: Get detailed order information with items

item.name: POST createProduct
item.description: Create a new product with images and variants

item.name: PUT updateProduct
item.description: Update a product with optional images

item.name: POST uploadProductImage
item.description: Upload an image for a product

item.name: GET getSupportWithOrderDetails
item.description: Get support ticket with order details

item.name: GET getSupportTicketsByOrderId
item.description: Get all support tickets for an order

item.name: GET getUserCart
item.description: Get cart for a specific user

item.name: GET getUserOrders
item.description: Get all orders for a specific user

item.name: POST register
item.description: Customer registration - send OTP to mobile

item.name: POST sendOtp
item.description: Send OTP to mobile (alias for register)

item.name: POST login
item.description: Customer login - verify OTP and get JWT

item.name: GET getActiveBanners
item.description: Get active banners with optional filters

item.name: POST incrementViews
item.description: Increment view count for a banner

item.name: POST incrementClicks
item.description: Increment click count for a banner

item.name: POST addToCart
item.description: Add item to cart (or update quantity if exists)

item.name: POST incrementQuantity
item.description: Increment quantity of item in cart

item.name: POST decrementQuantity
item.description: Decrement quantity of item in cart

item.name: POST checkout
item.description: Place an order from cart (authenticated user)

item.name: GET getAvailableCoupons
item.description: Get available coupons with optional platform filter

item.name: POST verifyCoupon
item.description: Verify coupon validity for authenticated user

item.name: GET getUserOrders
item.description: Get all orders for authenticated user

item.name: GET getOrderDetails
item.description: Get detailed information for a specific order

item.name: POST createProduct
item.description: Create a new product with images

item.name: POST createSupportTicket
item.description: Create a support ticket with optional images

item.name: POST createOrderQuery
item.description: Create an order-related query with optional images

item.name: GET checkWishlist
item.description: Check if product is in wishlist
